menu.draftTargetCancelled: This order was cancelled. Its old edit was archived and cannot be saved.
menu.draftReadFailed: The saved cart could not be read. Checkout is paused; the previous cart has been retained.
menu.draftSaveFailed: The cart could not be saved. Checkout is paused until its durable save succeeds.
menu.draftDiscardFailed: The saved cart could not be discarded. It has been retained.
menu.draftNeedsReconciliation: The original checkout still needs reconciliation. No new payment was started. Use payment recovery or ask a manager.
menu.draftRecoveryUnavailable: The original checkout could not be verified. Its saved cart remains protected.
menu.draftPending: The original checkout is retained. Confirm its result before starting another payment.
menu.draftRecovered: The original order has been restored.
menu.draftExistingTable: This table already has an active check. Open that check to add items.
menu.draftDeclinedResumed: The payment was declined. Your cart is restored; no new payment was started.
menu.draftNotSentResumed: No payment was sent. Your cart is restored; no new payment was started.
menu.draftNotChargedResumed: The original payment attempts did not charge the customer. Your cart is restored; no new payment was started.

legacyCurrency.title: Confirm the open shift currency
legacyCurrency.message: This shift was opened with an older version. Confirm that its opening cash and transactions were in {{currency}} before continuing. No amounts will be converted.
legacyCurrency.ready: Shift currency confirmed. You can continue to payment.
legacyCurrency.failed: The shift could not be confirmed. Check its currency and enter a manager PIN if required.

menu.editServerUpdate: Order corrections are temporarily unavailable. Check your connection and retry after the server update.
menu.editSyncRequired: The payment or order change has not synced yet. Your cart is saved. Try again shortly.
menu.emptyEditHint: To remove every item, close the editor and cancel the order.
menu.editCanonicalChanged: The order details need refreshing. Refresh the order before confirming a payment or refund.

checkoutRecovery.title: Table operations awaiting recovery
checkoutRecovery.guidance: Original requests remain saved. Internet and current permissions are required. Do not repeat an uncertain payment.
checkoutRecovery.unavailable: Recovery status could not be read. Pending operations have been retained.
checkoutRecovery.approval_required: Cancellation needs fresh staff or manager approval; reopen the original check.
checkoutRecovery.auth_required: Sign in with an authorized staff session to resume.
checkoutRecovery.conflict: Another terminal changed this check. Review its current state before continuing.

reasonCodes.table_cancellation_not_saved: The original table cancellation return has not been saved yet.
reasonCodes.edit_settlement_not_saved: A confirmed order correction is not saved yet. Its original collection or refund is retained.

fixCodes.table_cancellation_not_saved: Recover the original table cancellation. Do not hand back or refund the money again.
fixCodes.edit_settlement_not_saved: Reopen the saved order edit and save the same correction. Do not collect or return money again.
